versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.  
- No file modifications or updates were made.  
- Skill version and functionality remain the same as the previous release.

data-element-dx-skillkit 2.0.3

- Clarified "Gotchas"维护约定：仅允许主理人手工记录到 CHANGELOG.md，Agent 不得修改技能文档，Agent 仅能在交付报告中建议改进。
- 相应更新了 SKILL.md 和 dx-engagement-orchestrator/SKILL.md 的相关表述，使维护规范更明确。

Version 2.0.2

- Clarified "gotchas"维护规范，强调必须由项目主理人复盘后人工维护，静态 Markdown，禁止 Agent 自动改写或介入技能文档内容。
- 明确 Agent 只可在交付报告中提建议，文档需经复盘审核后变更，并需记录到 `CHANGELOG.md`。
- 微调“共享资源”与 gotchas 相关表述，统一术语与使用规范。

- Updated SKILL.md with comprehensive descriptions in Chinese and English for the entry point skill.
- Clarified usage scenarios, suite structure (7 sub-skills + shared resources), and routing logic.
- Added standard operating procedures, deliverable requirements (门禁, 口径, gotchas), and examples of sub-skill responsibilities.
- Clearly documented workflow for multi-stage and single-stage user requests.
- No functional changes to code detected; documentation only.
